tag.text: RCT · NEJM 2023 · 17,604 patients · CV disease · no diabetes

components.text: Tirzepatide's outcome trial, SURMOUNT-MMO, is due in October 2027, with no results yet

footnote: Source: SELECT (NEJM 2023, mean follow-up 39.8 months, BMI ≥27), ACC summary, ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05556512
notes: Only semaglutide has cardiovascular outcome evidence. SELECT enrolled 17,604 patients aged 45 or older with established cardiovascular disease, a BMI of 27 or more and no diabetes, followed for 39.8 months on average. The primary endpoint, cardiovascular death, non-fatal heart attack or non-fatal stroke, occurred in 569 patients, 6.5%, on semaglutide and 701, 8.0%, on placebo: a hazard ratio of 0.80, with a 95% confidence interval of 0.72 to 0.90. Cardiovascular death alone had a hazard ratio of 0.85 with an interval crossing 1, so it was not significant. Death from any cause had a hazard ratio of 0.81 and the heart failure composite 0.82. China approved the matching indication for Wegovy on December 16, 2025: to reduce major cardiovascular events in adults with established cardiovascular disease and a BMI of at least 27. Tirzepatide's equivalent trial, SURMOUNT-MMO, is still running, with primary completion expected in October 2027. SELECT also had a cost: 16.6% stopped for adverse events against 8.2%, and 10.0% against 2.0% for gastrointestinal events.
